intent: Prevent Phaser advanced word-wrap errors during active-capture resize, including transient 4px parent sizes and recovery across the compact breakpoint. Preserve authoritative chess state, capture completion, Skip, Undo, cleanup, and navigation. Add production-browser regression coverage for generic and Fire Dragon presenters; document evidence and limitations; deliver a draft PR against recovery/2026-10-22 without merge/deploy. Existing Phase 2/3 plans provide background; no new explicit implementation plan applies.

evidence: e2e/attack_resize.spec.js:40-45 taps Skip conditionally but does not assert completion until after the unconditional six-second playback advance; lines 56-58 repeat this for Escape.

src/game/animation/AttackRegistry.ts:24-28 defines Fire Dragon timings of 800ms preparation, 800ms strike, and 1000ms recovery; FireDragonPresenter.ts:160-163 derives its natural timeline from these values, shorter than the six-second assertion delay.

e2e/game.spec.js:58-60 and 108-110 advance only 32ms after Skip before asserting idle, demonstrating the existing immediate-completion assertion pattern. The existing resized Skip case uses only the generic capture.
findings.suggested_fix: Inside the Skip branch, advance the paused clock by 32ms and assert idle plus black's turn immediately after tapCanvas, following e2e/game.spec.js. Do the same after Escape at line 56. Retain the subsequent 6000ms advance and final state assertions to detect stale timers; keep the full advance for natural completion cases.
findings.title: Assert Skip completion before natural playback finishes
findings.why_it_matters: The new Skip cases still pass if the restored canvas ignores the Skip tap: advancing six seconds allows both presenters to finish naturally before any completion assertion. The same issue affects the Escape check after recapture. This leaves Skip after the forced 4px recovery, especially the Fire Dragon path absent from the existing resize Skip test, unverified. Assert completion after a short frame advance, then advance past the original timeline to verify cleanup.
findings.validation_reason: If Skip or Escape is ignored after resize or recapture, the new tests in e2e/attack_resize.spec.js:40-58 still advance 6000ms before asserting completion, allowing the natural completion callbacks in AttackScene.ts:308-314 and FireDragonPresenter.ts:538-542 to satisfy the same assertions for the registry timings; the test itself reaches these input paths, and incidence of an ignored input was not measured.
